list.name: Changes
list.comment:
refactor: lift OCR summary state and add loading indicators to job components
- Moved OCR summary state management and polling logic out of `OcrSummaryPanel` to be handled via props. - Added visual loading spinners to the headers of `OcrSummaryPanel`, `JobArtifactsList`, and `JobStatusCard` when jobs or document generation are active. - Updated `JobStatusCard` to display "Avvio in corso" during the initial loading phase. - Adjusted status checks in `OcrSummaryPanel` and `JobArtifactsList` to include the `review_required` state. - Refined conditional rendering logic for summary text and error messages in the OCR panel.
